name: EyeSpy
description: Demand-signal research tool — reads compliant sources (Reddit API, search API, Google Places reviews, RSS, open data, podcast) plus weekly manual Facebook Group screenshot capture for a region, classifies each signal demand/supply/irrelevant, computes a gap_score per theme, and buckets them into Clear gaps/Rising but crowded/Watch, surfacing a ranked digest to feed product ideation.
location: apps/ops (/eyespy, /eyespy/[themeId], /eyespy/capture, /eyespy/sources, /eyespy/digest, /eyespy/merge-themes, /eyespy/purge-themes), this repo — live and pulling real signals from 10 sources: IOL RSS, GroundUp Q&A RSS, GroundUp News RSS, Daily Maverick RSS, CapeTalk consumer podcast, Cape Town Service Requests (ArcGIS), Google Search, Brave Search, Google Places (business reviews), plus manual Facebook Group capture. Every signal is classified demand/supply/unclear/irrelevant (irrelevant added 2026-08-03 after general national news from the RSS sources was flooding the theme pool), with gap_score/trend/volume counting demand only. Two one-time cleanup tools built 2026-08-03 for backlog fixed by bugs since patched: /eyespy/merge-themes (duplicate themes from an earlier classification-cap bug) and /eyespy/purge-themes (off-topic news themes from the relevance bug) — see next steps for the run order. Reddit built but blocked on an account hold. Google Trends alpha still open (low priority).

nextSteps.step: Run the two cleanup tools in order, then generate the first real digest: /eyespy/merge-themes first (merges duplicate themes), then /eyespy/purge-themes (deletes off-topic news themes), then click 'Regenerate digest now' on /eyespy/digest. Order matters — a digest scored against fragmented or off-topic themes would misrepresent what's actually a gap
detail: Migration apps/ops/prisma/migrations/20260803120000_add_digest_gap_score/migration.sql and apps/ops/prisma/migrations/20260803140000_add_irrelevant_signal_type/migration.sql need hand-applying via the Query tool first if not already done.

Ticket filed with Reddit. Parked, not urgent — everything else is live without it. lib/ingest/reddit.ts is already built and wired in (client_credentials OAuth, r/CapeTown + r/southafrica search for "Durbanville"), just needs REDDIT_CLIENT_ID/REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET once the account is unblocked

nextSteps.step: Apply for Google Trends API (alpha) access — new official API (launched July 2025), free for approved testers, gives quantified search-intent data to cross-check qualitative sources. Not urgent, approval timeline unknown

If marketplace/multi-operator mode is wanted later, look into PayFast's Split Payments feature in their docs — no separate gateway migration needed per the 2026-07-29 decision.
